ExpressContextLibrarySummary.description:
A single AEC library as returned by GET /aec-libraries.

NOTE: `developerName` includes the 8-char hash suffix the platform appends on creation (e.g. `General_FAQ_Express_6def866f`). Path-style lookups by the plain, un-suffixed name 404; use the full developerName or the 18-char Id (key prefix 1JD).

ExpressContextRetrieverDetail.description:
Types for the Agentforce Express Context (AEC) Connect API.

AEC is a realtime BM25 index/retrieval service that bypasses the Data Cloud DLO/DMO/SearchIndex pipeline used by Agentforce Data Libraries (ADL). Because of that, AEC libraries are lighter-weight than ADL libraries: there is no data-space scope, no downstream DMO/SearchIndex assets, and indexing is (near-)realtime rather than a multi-stage provisioning pipeline.

Connect API base: /services/data/v{version}/einstein/aec-libraries
